keyPoints.en: Motif → develop (repeat, sequence, vary) → phrases → form (AB, ABA).
keyPoints.bm: Motif → kembangkan (ulang, jujukan, ubah) → frasa → bentuk (AB, ABA).

keyPoints.en: Ostinato = repeated pattern; call and response = leader and group; improvisation = made up on the spot.
keyPoints.bm: Ostinato = corak berulang; panggilan dan sahutan = ketua dan kumpulan; improvisasi = dicipta secara spontan.

keyPoints.en: Stand tall, relax shoulders, breathe from the diaphragm, warm up gently.
keyPoints.bm: Berdiri tegak, santaikan bahu, bernafas dengan diafragma, panaskan suara dengan lembut.

keyPoints.en: Recorder: blow gently and cover the holes fully with finger pads.
keyPoints.bm: Rekorder: tiup perlahan dan tutup lubang sepenuhnya dengan hujung jari.

keyPoints.en: Rehearse often, follow the conductor, record and review.
keyPoints.bm: Berlatih kerap, ikut konduktor, rakam dan nilai semula.

keyPoints.en: Stage etiquette: enter neatly, bow, keep going after mistakes. Audience: quiet, clap at the end.
keyPoints.bm: Etika pentas: masuk dengan kemas, tunduk hormat, teruskan selepas kesilapan. Penonton: diam, bertepuk di akhir.

tip.en: If you make a mistake, keep the beat — never stop.
tip.bm: Jika tersilap, kekalkan detik — jangan berhenti.
